data.name: Boxed Up!
data.detailed_description:
"Welcome back to hell, now with added hell!"

The world is being overrun by monsters, the last hope? A parcel delivery company

Boxed up is a first-person Parcel-Scanning simulation game with a ghoulish twist! Certain boxes contain monsters, and its up to you to figure it out, match the given stats to the box's actual measurements and info. Your office contains many gadgets and gizmos to help you find fault in the boxes. If something doesn't match, its a discrepancy, and the box must be thrown out, as it will contain a monster.

Each day the monsters will adapt and new discrepancies will arise, along with the quota of boxes needed! Make sure to upgrade and keep your machines healthy so you can keep up with the increased demand.

Who knows what you'll unpack in Boxed Up!

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Box Sorter – Contract Position

(For Official Applicants Only)

As a world-class organization, the Box Company™ is passionate about warehouses, packaging, delivery, and excellence! As Box Sorter, your role will be to act as a champion of quality, destroying discrepant packages that do not follow our strict Box Company™ standards.

With your skills, you will keep all Box Company™ boxes to this standard, faultless and troll free!*

*The Box Company™ denies any and all claims of trolls infiltrating our packaging. Such claims are without evidence and are fabricated by conspirators.

What You’ll Do

· Act as a final assurance of quality, checking each box individually for discrepancies.

· Perform tests with top-of-the-line Box Company™ equipment, such as the Metal Detector, state of the art computers from decades past, and exciting barcode scanners!

· Proactively work with other disciplines, using our unique industry standard E-mail system to correspond and communicate with our various teams.

· Meet your quota of boxes each shift, motivated by our fair and infallible strike system.

· Send off our troll-free boxes to be delivered, ensuring no non-existent trolls have not un-infiltrated our packaging.

Scanner & Computer

The scanner is the bread and butter of any good box sorter. Competent workers scan labels for details about their package, a helpful tool in analysing for discrepancies.

Info desk

We understand that many workers are forgetful, that’s why we’ve installed a secondary computer to your workstation with all the relevant information needed to remind you again and again!

Scale

Measure the weight of all your packages with this industrial grade scale! A necessary tool for confirming details of your package, this scale will ensure no box-related problems ever weigh on you again.

Metal detector

Some packages come with declarations of contents, and metal is an important one to keep track of for the Box Company™. Use this heavy-duty machine to search packages for traces of metal and confirm their contents.

(DO NOT PLACE ANY LIMBS OR BODY PARTS INSIDE THE MACHINE AT ANY TIME)

Sorter / incinerator

When your job is done correctly, it’s time to send off the package to be delivered or destroyed. Luckily, your sorting machine will do the legwork for you. Simply pull the right lever to send your package off or watch it burn before your eyes!

Footnote

The Box Company™ is excited to hire you! We hope you apply for this unmissable opportunity soon, to become a valued cog in our welcoming and friendly machine, and we hope to receive your application Boxed Up!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 9600x 6-Core Processor
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce RTX 1660
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 9600x 6-Core Processor
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce RTX 4070
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • VR Support: No
